statement: 可运行 Reference Demo 能证明机制和交互契约，但不能冒充生产 UI 或视觉基线；生产截图/录屏证明某次真实实现，Golden Baseline 才承担受控状态下的视觉回归参照。Foundry 应显式标注这三种证据层级。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.UIGS.SHOWCASE_EVIDENCE_LADDER; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
